title: An INTEREST REFUND on a CHARGED-OFF loan merges principal 41.76 and interest 0.15 into ONE credit to INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_INTEREST 17 (loan 3 L33: credit 41.91, debit 41.91)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry an INTEREST_REFUND posted on loan 3 (product LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INT_DAILY_EMI_ACTUAL_ACTUAL_INT_REFUND_FULL_ZERO_INT_CHARGE_OFF, CHARGED OFF) on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits). The dispatch posts an interest refund through the SAME method as an interest-payment waiver (AccrualBasedAccountingProcessorForLoan.java:134-135, isInterestPaymentWaiver() || isInterestRefund()), and the seam request carries the portions, the charged-off flag and the slot->account mapping only. request.interest_payment_waiver_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back transaction id 33 (externalId L33, type loanTransactionType.interestRefund): principalPortion 41.76 -> "4176" AND interestPortion 0.15 -> "15"; fee/penalty/overpayment 0. The charged-off state is the read-back's top-level chargedOff true, and the read-back's chargeOff transaction id 31 (amount 444.23, 2025-06-10) precedes L33, so BOTH positive slots resolve to the charged-off credit account. accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INT_DAILY_EMI_ACTUAL_ACTUAL_INT_REFUND_FULL_ZERO_INT_CHARGE_OFF.json (sha256 bade51ab...9b43): loanPortfolio 7, receivable interest/fee/penalty 4, overpayment 16, interestOnLoan 9, incomeFromChargeOffInterest 17 -- so principal 4176 + interest 15 both credit 17. expect.interest_payment_waiver_journal_legs is the ONE merged credit and the ONE debit the sweep records in id order: JE 98 CREDIT account 17 41.91, JE 99 DEBIT account 9 41.91. THIS VECTOR GRADES: the charged-off merge. A journal that posts one credit per positive slot would emit two credits (17 4176 and 17 15) plus a split debit, which is the exact wrong implementation `loan-wrong-ipw-charged-off-credits-not-merged` models; the merged single credit is what this vector pins. Nothing was computed: every portion, account and leg is read directly from the committed files; amounts are exact decimals parsed to integer minor units, never a float.
